verdict.rationale: Crossmint is API-first, so it can run without a UI. Its headless checkout is a set of REST APIs that support server-side keys and work outside a browser, and agents get delegated signers that transact with "no user prompt per action." Webhooks and order-status polling support unattended automation. missing for 10: no CLI or CI-specific guidance, no OpenAPI spec found (probes returned 404), no staging environment for agent checkouts (production-only testing), and card setup requires an interactive user passkey verification step.
